title: Chat Selector
description: Client-side chat highlighter with a compact color picker for selected player nicknames.
body:
This client-side mod improves chat readability by allowing you to highlight selected player nicknames with custom colors. Using a compact and simple color picker, you can quickly assign colors to specific players so their messages stand out in chat.

The mod works entirely on the client, so it does not require installation on a server and is compatible with both singleplayer and multiplayer. The interface is minimal and easy to use, letting you change colors in real time without interrupting gameplay.

It is lightweight and designed to integrate smoothly with the default chat, keeping the original look while adding a small but useful layer of customization.
